## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes and why.

Closes # (issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Refactoring / performance optimization

## Checklist
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) guide and followed the project standards.
- [ ] I have adhered to the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] My code follows the repository's code style and passes lint checks.
- [ ] I have run local tests (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`) and verified they pass.
- [ ] If changing verification or serialization logic, I have included falsifiability tests (demonstrating it fails on corrupted input).
- [ ] If changing schemas, CLI, or behavior, I have updated the corresponding documentation.
